title: SEND in the experts with Georgina Durrant - Videos
channel: SEND in the experts with Georgina Durrant
description:
The UK's most popular Special Educational Needs (SEND) podcast hosted by Georgina Durrant is all about teaching and supporting children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). We aim to share the amazing things that our guests are doing to support children and young people with Special Educational Needs (SEND).

You can also find the SEND in the Experts podcast on Spotify, Apple Podcast, and most other podcast providers.

*This Podcast is proudly brought to you by the SEND team at Twinkl. The views and opinions expressed are those of individuals, and may not represent those of Twinkl.
